terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to TaskCoper. By using our platform, you agree to comply with the following terms.

accounts.title: 1. User Accounts
accounts.content: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and all activities that occur under it. Providing accurate information is mandatory.

management.title: 2. Project & Task Management
management.content: TaskCoper provides tools for managing projects, task cards, and team collaboration. Users are responsible for the content and data they upload.

mentoring.title: 3. Mentoring Services
mentoring.content: The platform connects Experts (Mentors) and Users (Mentees). All agreements regarding meetings and mentoring roadmaps must comply with our professional conduct rules.

payments.title: 4. Payments & Refunds
payments.content: Mentor Packages and transactions on the platform are processed securely. Refunds will be considered based on the specific policy of each package.

ip.title: 5. Intellectual Property
ip.content: All features and designs of TaskCoper are owned by us. Your project content remains yours.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data.

collection.title: 1. Data Collection
collection.content: We collect profile information (name, email, avatar) and activity data (projects, tasks, meeting history) to improve our services.

usage.title: 2. Data Usage
usage.content: Your information is used to operate the platform, support AI advisors, and facilitate connections between Mentors and Mentees.

security.title: 3. Data Security
security.content: We apply standard security measures to prevent unauthorized access or leakage of user data.

rights.title: 4. User Rights
rights.content: You have the right to access, edit, or request deletion of your personal data at any time through account settings.

punctuality.title: Did the mentor show up on time and manage the schedule effectively?
punctuality.label: Punctuality

options.4: Started exactly on time and managed the schedule perfectly.
options.3: Mostly on time, minor delays but communicated well.
options.2: Noticeably late or rushed the meeting.
options.1: Very late, no-show, or highly disrespectful of time.

preparation.title: Did the mentor review your project details before the meeting?
preparation.label: Preparation

options.4: Thoroughly reviewed materials and understood the context immediately.
options.3: Skimmed the materials, had a basic understanding of the startup.
options.2: Unprepared, had to explain everything from scratch.
options.1: Completely unprepared or confused the project with another.

quality.title: Was the feedback valuable for your current stage?
quality.label: Quality

options.4: Deeply insightful, solved core problems directly.
options.3: Helpful and provided a good general direction.
options.2: Somewhat generic, lacking specific depth for the industry.
options.1: Irrelevant, outdated, or fundamentally incorrect advice.

communication.title: Was the mentor actively listening and engaging?
communication.label: Communication

options.4: Exceptionally clear, engaged, and actively listened.
options.3: Professional, clear, and easy to converse with.
options.2: Dominated the conversation or used confusing jargon.
options.1: Condescending, dismissive, or hard to communicate with.

actionability.title: Did you walk away knowing exactly what to do next?
actionability.label: Actionability

options.4: Provided a clear, step-by-step action plan.
options.3: Suggested a few practical next steps to try.
options.2: Mostly theoretical advice, hard to apply immediately.
options.1: No clear takeaways or next steps were established.
